focus: Correctness — environment precedence and switch value semantics

findingDetails.title: An explicit sentinel value falls through to the config file
findingDetails.evidence: REQ-002 says a set environment value wins even when falsy. The shell resolver substitutes the literal __HF_UNSET__ for absence and compares the resolved value to that sentinel; if the environment value equals it, the resolver reads the config instead. [SOURCE: specs/sk-doc/062-doc-validation-off-switches/spec.md:129-130] [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/shared/hook-flags.sh:37-44]
findingDetails.recommendation: Detect whether the variable is set separately from its value, then use the config only when the variable is genuinely absent; add a regression row for the sentinel literal.
findingDetails.scopeProof: REQ-002 defines environment precedence for all set values; hook_flag_on routes the named switch through this resolver after name validation.
